dct_creator_sm: Arnott, Shelley (Queen's University. Department of Biology, Queen's University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3834-703X
dct_description_sm: To assess how water hardness (as calcium) influences the toxicity of chloride (as NaCl) to Daphnia app.,  we conducted 48-hour acute chloride (as NaCl) toxicity tests on < 24-hour old Daphnia neonates in six calcium treatments: 1.5, 3, 15, 40, 70, and 128 mg/L (hardness ~7 to 323 mgCaCO3/L) at chloride concentrations ranging from 0.39 to 3400 mg/L.  We determined the effective concentration of chloride which was lethal to 50%, 25%, and 10% of the sample populations (EC50, EC25, and EC10, respectively) from each iso-female line in each calcium treatment after 48 hours of exposure without food.
dct_title_s: Data for "The effect of calcium on acute chloride toxicity in Daphnia species"
